This portfolio brings together some of the projects I've been developing in this learning process.

project.morslum.description: Interactive platform for morphosyntactic analysis of the Portuguese language using NLP.
project.morslum.about: Academic platform for morphosyntactic analysis of the Portuguese language using NLP with spaCy. Grammatically classifies each word in a sentence, generates SVG syntactic dependency trees, and offers an educational quiz with 500 Brazilian Portuguese sentences. Scientific Initiation project at FATEC Ipiranga built with React and PrimeReact, Flask API, Docker Compose, and desktop packaging via Electron with a portable Python runtime.
project.morslum.architecture: The application follows a three-layer architecture: the React frontend with PrimeReact consumes a REST API built with Flask, which in turn uses spaCy for the linguistic processing pipeline. The entire infrastructure can be orchestrated with Docker Compose (Backend + Frontend served by Nginx). For desktop distribution, Electron packages the compiled frontend together with a portable Python 3.12 runtime containing Flask, spaCy, and all necessary dependencies — eliminating the need for manual Python or package installation by the end user.

project.translog.description: Modern internal (intranet) dashboard connected to a legacy system via SOAP. Express acts as an intermediary REST API between the React frontend and the legacy SOAP backend.
project.translog.about: Intranet delivery management dashboard connected to a legacy system via SOAP. An intermediary Express REST API translates frontend calls to SOAP Web Services exposed by the Spring Boot backend. Features delivery registration, status timeline tracking, validated status transitions, and an ECharts dashboard. Fully Dockerized with Docker Compose and PostgreSQL database.
project.translog.architecture: TransLog follows a three-layer architecture: the React frontend consumes an intermediary REST API built with Express, which communicates with the legacy backend via SOAP Web Services. The Spring Boot backend exposes SOAP operations (creation, tracking, update, and cancellation of deliveries) following XSD contracts. PostgreSQL stores the data. Express acts as a translator between the frontend's REST format and the legacy system's SOAP protocol. The entire application is Dockerized with Docker Compose.

project.pgpweblab.description: PGP key generator, message and file encryption/decryption — 100% client-side.
project.pgpweblab.about: OpenPGP cryptography tool that runs 100% in the browser. Built with Angular and Bootstrap, uses OpenPGP.js to generate RSA keys, encrypt and decrypt messages and files locally — no data sent to servers. Static application compiled and deployed on Vercel, ensuring private keys never leave the user's device.
project.pgpweblab.architecture: PGP Web Lab is a Single Page Application (SPA) built with Angular, running all processing in the client's browser. The interface uses Bootstrap and Bootstrap Icons for a responsive and modern experience. OpenPGP.js handles all cryptographic operations — from RSA key pair generation to message and file encryption/decryption. i18n support (English/Portuguese) is implemented natively with Angular i18n. The application is compiled into static files and deployed on Vercel, with no backend or intermediary server.

project.startdoor.description: Centralized repository where students and interns register reports and reviews about organizations, with personalized AI recommendations.
project.startdoor.about: Collaborative platform that eliminates information asymmetry about internships. Centralizes anonymous company reviews across 12 competencies with 1–5 ratings and textual reports. Uses AI (Google Gemini) for personalized recommendations based on student profile. Final project at FATEC Ipiranga developed by a team of 5 students, featuring JWT authentication, full CRUD, Docker Compose, and CI/CD via GitHub Actions.
project.startdoor.architecture: Startdoor follows a three-layer architecture: the React frontend with TypeScript and Vite consumes a REST API built with Spring Boot and Java. The backend uses Spring Security with JWT authentication and Hibernate/JPA for MySQL persistence. Integration with the Google Gemini API enables personalized company recommendations for each student based on 12 evaluated competencies. The frontend uses MobX for state management, Tailwind CSS for styling, and React Hook Form with Zod for form validation. The entire application is containerized with Docker Compose (MySQL + Backend + Frontend) and has automated CI/CD via GitHub Actions that publishes images to Docker Hub.
